nodes.name: Delta Notes Webhook
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential is deliberately not attached in this exported JSON (never commit real secrets) — create an httpHeaderAuth credential (header name e.g. X-Auth-Token, value = a random shared secret) and attach it to this node's Authentication after import. The same URL + token go into the watchapp's on-phone config page. responseMode is 'lastNode' so the phone only gets a success response after the note is actually written.

nodes.name: Build Note
nodes.notes: Filename doubles as the note title (Obsidian convention) — timestamp + first few words of the dictated text, sanitized for filesystem-unsafe characters. 'Watch Inbox/' is created automatically by obsidian_create_note (create_parents defaults true).

nodes.name: Create Note
nodes.notes: Calls obsidian-mcp's obsidian_create_note tool directly — deliberately no AI Agent/LLM in this workflow, this is a deterministic save, not a research task. endpointUrl assumes mcp-obsidian is reachable on n8n's own Docker network (either this repo's docker-compose, standalone mode, or the pebble-index-research-agent stack, integrated mode) — see docs/SETUP.md for both. vault name ('notes') must match mcp-obsidian's VAULT_NAME env var.
